MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
